# tools.gokhangunduz.dev

Read `AGENTS.md` at the repository root before proposing any change. It is the
single working contract: scope discipline, the verification ladder, the invariants
and the commit convention. The rules below are its short form.

- Do one declared task. Log anything else you notice instead of fixing it.
- Never report work as done without running the matching script under `verify/`.
- Nothing the visitor types leaves the browser: no API route, server action, proxy or third-party script. A tool that calls an API sets `network: true`.
- Every visible string exists in Turkish and English: `t(locale, key)` for the shell, a `Localized` `{ tr, en }` in the tool.
- Colours come from the tokens in `src/app/globals.css`; never a hex value in a component.
- A tool's work is a pure function in `logic.ts` with a vitest `logic.test.ts`; user errors are `ToolError` in both languages.
- Commits are `<type>(<scope>): <emoji> <subject>` and never carry an AI co-author trailer.
